info.title: Fessior API Document
info.description: Tài liệu API cho hệ thống Online Code Judge

post.description: Create a new user account with email and password. Returns created user object (without password).

password.description: Plain text password (min length depends on validator)

post.description: Authenticate with email (or username) and password. Returns access and refresh tokens.
Invalidate a refresh token to log out a session. Requires Authorization header.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token.

get.description: Returns the profile information of the authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates the profile information (full_name, bio) of the authenticated user.

data.bio: I love coding and solving problems!

bio.example: I love coding and solving problems!

example.bio: I love coding and solving problems!

post.description: Change the password for the authenticated user. Requires current password.

delete.description: Revoke a previously issued session (by sessionId). Requires Authorization header.

parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: ID of the session to revoke

delete.summary: Revoke all sessions for current user
delete.description: Invalidate all refresh tokens / sessions for the authenticated user.

post.description: Send a password reset email with a one-time token to the provided email address.

example.message: Password reset email sent if account exists

post.description: Reset a user password using the token sent to email via forgot-password.

get.description: Returns public profile information of a user by username. Does not require authentication.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username of the user to retrieve

get.description: Returns paginated list of accepted submissions by a specific user (code is hidden).

get.summary: Get public tag statistics by username
get.description: Returns number of problems solved by tag for a specific user.
Return paginated submissions created by the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a submission for a problem; code is queued for judging.
Upload an image file to set as user avatar. Supports JPEG, PNG, JPG, WEBP (max 5MB).

400.description: No file uploaded or invalid file type

delete.description: Deletes the current user avatar from Cloudinary and resets avatar_url to null.

get.description: Returns paginated list of code submissions by the authenticated user.
Returns list of badges that the authenticated user has earned.
Returns number of problems solved by the authenticated user, grouped by tag.
Returns paginated history of ELO rating changes for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get current user streak and heatmap
get.description: Returns current streak, max streak, and calendar heatmap of problem-solving activity for the last 365 days.

200.description: User streak and heatmap retrieved successfully

heatmap.description: Map of date (YYYY-MM-DD) to number of problems solved

get.description: Get detailed result for a submission including per-testcase results.

patch.description: Allows admin to update user information (username, email, full_name, bio, elo_rating, code_coins).

put.description: Update problem metadata and statement. Admin only.

delete.description: Remove a problem and associated testcases. Admin only.

patch.description: Allows admin to change a user\'s role between USER and ADMIN.

post.description: Locks a user account. Banned users cannot authenticate or access protected APIs.
Restores a banned user account. User can login and access protected APIs again.

get.summary: Get public user elo history by username
get.description: Returns paginated elo history for a specific user.

get.summary: Get public user streak by username
get.description: Returns streak count and heatmap for a specific user.

get.summary: Get match history for current user
get.description: Return a paginated list of past matches for the authenticated user.

get.summary: Get active match for current user
get.description: Returns the pending match the user is currently participating in.
Return detailed information for a specific match including moves, verdicts, and participants.

delete.description: Remove a match record. Admin only.

get.description: Return all available problem tags used for filtering and categorization.

post.description: Create a new problem tag. Requires admin privileges.
Add input/output testcase for a problem. Admin only.

get.description: Return public metadata about testcases (not secret answers) — admin may access full data.

delete.description: Delete a testcase by id. Admin only.

post.description: Execute code ad-hoc without creating a persistent submission. Useful for quick testing.
